summary: WISeSat.Space Holdings Corp., a BVI-domiciled space technology company, filed a Form 6-K reporting the October 1, 2026 closing of its previously announced business combination with Columbus Acquisition Corp (CAC), a Nasdaq-listed SPAC, with the press release issued October 2, 2026. The combined company's ordinary shares were to begin trading on Nasdaq on October 2, 2026, following the de-SPAC transaction. No price per share, premium, stake percentage, advisor, or break fee was disclosed in the excerpt. The filing notes risk factors around listing maintenance and post-closing cash position, typical de-SPAC overhang considerations for arbitrageurs.
